newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $15.712 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $15.712 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's total foreign reserves rose $129 million, or 0.8 percent, in the week to April 28 to $15.712 billion, according to new figures released by the central bank.
Reserves were up from $15.583 billion on April 21, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Since the start of the year, reserves have risen $533 million, or 3.5 percent.
Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year to $15.179 billion and government officials have forecast they will grow to $20 billion by the end of 1997.
